 Hyderabad Remains Pleasant As Cyclone Arnab Impacts Ap Imd Forecasts Intense Showers In Eastern Telangana 
 Hyderabad remains pleasant as cyclone Arnab impacts AP; IMD forecasts intense showers in eastern Telangana
 Hyderabad has experienced cloudy skies and cool breezes as Cyclone Arnab influences weather conditions across Telangana. The IMD has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall in parts of the eastern districts, while the city is expected to receive less rain.
 By 
 Telangana Today 
 Updated On - 28 October 2026, 02:03 PM 
 Photo: Surya Sridhar 
 Hyderabad: Hyderabad and its neighbouring districts continue to experience a spell of pleasant weather, marked by overcast skies and cool breeze for the past 24 hours. Inclement weather conditions have remained active in districts as well, even as several regions of neighboring Andhra Pradesh bear the brunt of the Arnab cyclone system. Nighttime temperatures have steadily dropped, currently hovering comfortably in the range of 19 degrees Celsius and 20 degrees Celsius.
 According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), Hyderabad forecast, minimum temperatures in various parts of the city have dipped, with areas under GHMC like Patancheru recording 19.2 degrees Celsius while Medak district recording a low of 18.8 degrees Celsius. Daytime maximum temperatures too have remained stable at around 31 degrees Celsius to 32 degrees Celsius, maintaining a comfortable balance throughout the day.
 Meanwhile, the IMD, Hyderabad bulletin, regarding the impact of the severe cyclone system active between October 27 and 29, said that heavy to very heavy rainfall along with intense downpours and gusty winds are expected in eastern region of Telangana including Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, and Mahabubabad.
 The central and northern districts of the State including Warangal, Peddapalli, Mancherial, and Karimnagar will witness moderate rains with isolated heavy spells.
 In contrast, Hyderabad and western districts like Rangareddy, Sangareddy, and Vikarabad remain largely dry and are expected to experience light, isolated showers and a breezy ambiance as the system moves past the coast.
